top_signals.title: S&P 500 Wavers as Tech Drop Spurs Stock Rotation: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street traders drove a rotation out of tech giants and into a broader category of stocks while fueling a push toward the perceived safety of bonds.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Anthropic shares plunge as AI fears erase debut gains
top_signals.summary: Anthropic’s shares plunged at market open on Friday, as investors’ fears over the AI boom wiped away most of the gains from its record-breaking debut. The Claude maker’s shares fell as much as 10 per cent per cent to $87.8 (£66.9) after Wall Street’s opening bell, a sharp reversal from its 17 per cent surge [...]
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
